changelog:
Initial release of NSFW Detector Pro.

- Advanced detection of explicit content in images, videos, and text with configurable sensitivity.
- Real-time and batch processing supported, including skin tone and age estimation.
- Highly customizable with multiple models, sensitivity presets, and context-aware filters.
- Provides confidence scores, supports GPU acceleration, and includes art/medical content filters.
- Ideal for content moderation across social media, user-generated platforms, e-commerce, and more.
summary: Detects and classifies explicit content in images, videos, and text using deep learning with configurable sensitivity and context-aware filters.
